run_form_composer_task: run a mephisto form composer dynamic task locally using the inhouse operator
generate_task_data_config: generate an extrapolated task_data.json config from form unit and token sets values config files
build_form_composer_dynamic: build the dynamic form composer react app with optional force rebuild and post install script
set_form_composer_env_vars: set the environment variables required for the form composer task to run correctly
launch_and_wait_for_task: launch a mephisto task run and wait for completion then shutdown the operator
